neuron_definition: one Dense output unit = one kernel column plus matching bias entry
safety_filter: single neuron must have low-K net >= 0, poly net >= 0, and global net > 0 versus freeze_local_combo
cumulative_selection: inner validation only; maximize global net subject to low-K net >= 0 and poly net >= 0
control: also evaluate cumulative swaps ordered only by parameter delta norm
